Good.headline: Air quality is good
Good.advice: Minimal impact. Enjoy outdoor activities as usual.

Satisfactory.headline: Air quality is satisfactory
Satisfactory.advice: Minor breathing discomfort is possible for very sensitive people.
Satisfactory.sensitive: People with lung or heart disease may prefer lighter outdoor exertion.

Moderate.headline: Air quality is moderate
Moderate.advice: May cause breathing discomfort to people with lung disease, asthma or heart disease, children and older adults.
Moderate.sensitive: Limit prolonged outdoor exertion; keep rescue medication handy.

Poor.headline: Air quality is poor
Poor.advice: Breathing discomfort on prolonged exposure. Reduce long outdoor activity.
Poor.sensitive: Stay indoors where possible; consider an N95 mask outdoors.

Very Poor.headline: Air quality is very poor
Very Poor.advice: Respiratory illness on prolonged exposure. Avoid outdoor exercise.
Very Poor.sensitive: Stay indoors, keep windows closed, use an air purifier if available.

Severe.headline: Air quality is severe
Severe.advice: Serious health effects even for healthy people. Avoid all outdoor activity.
Severe.sensitive: Remain indoors. Seek medical help if you have breathing difficulty.
